q: is a revealed book from Allaah, the Mighty, the Wise.
v.s: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
v.c: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.

q: Undoubtedly, We have revealed the Book to you
with the truth, so worship Allaah, making Deen
v.s: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship God, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
v.c: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth, so worship Allah ˹alone˺, being sincerely devoted to Him.

m: that they may bring us near
q: is exclusively for Allaah. Those people who take others
as partners of Allaah say, “We worship them only so that they may draw us close to Allaah
(without really believing that they are as powerful as Allaah).”
Verily Allaah shall decide between them
concerning the matters about which they differ
Undoubtedly, Allaah does not guide the one who is a liar
(in his beliefs). (Such a person refuses to accept the truth and will therefore not be rightly guided).
v.s: Unquestionably, for God is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God in position." Indeed, God will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, God does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
v.c: Indeed, sincere devotion is due ˹only˺ to Allah. As for those who take other lords besides Him, ˹saying,˺ “We worship them only so they may bring us closer to Allah,” surely Allah will judge between all regarding what they differed about. Allah certainly does not guide whoever persists in lying and disbelief.

q: to have a child, He would have chosen whatever He desires from His creation
(and is not forced to take those whom the Mushrikeen name as His children). (However, the fact is that)
and He is the One, the Omnipotent.
v.s: If God had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is God, the One, the Prevailing.
v.c: Had it been Allah’s Will to have offspring, He could have chosen whatever He willed of His creation. Glory be to Him! He is Allah—the One, the Supreme.

q: He has created the heavens and the earth
He folds the night into the day, folds the day into the night
(one comes after the other without intervals),
and has subjugated the sun and the moon. Each one runs to a prescribed term
(for a stipulated time when all will eventually come to an end).
Behold! He is the Mighty, the Most Forgiving.
v.s: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
v.c: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He wraps the night around the day, and wraps the day around the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon, each orbiting for an appointed term. He is truly the Almighty, Most Forgiving.

q: after which He made a spouse
from the soul, and also made eight pairs
Allaah creates you in the wombs of your mothers, as a creation after a creation
(taking you through various stages of foetal development as described in Sura An'aam)
(the abdomen, the womb, and the membrane in which the foetus develops).
That is Allaah, your Rabb, to Whom all kingdoms belong. There is none worthy of worship but He, so where are you turning to?
(Why are you turning to worship other gods when it is Allaah Who gave you everything?)
v.s: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is God, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
v.c: He created you ˹all˺ from a single soul, then from it He made its mate. And He produced for you four pairs of cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers ˹in stages˺, one development after another, in three layers of darkness. That is Allah—your Lord! All authority belongs to Him. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be turned away?

q: Allaah is certainly Independent of you
(and does not need your worship). (However, this does not permit anyone to commit kufr because)
Allaah is not pleased with kufr for His slaves
(for all He gives you and worship only Him),
this is what He likes for you. None shall bear the burden of another
(person's sins because every person will have to account for his/her own sins).
(after spending your lives in this world)
your return shall be to your Rabb, Who will inform you of what you used to do
(and either reward or punish you for your actions).
Verily, He has knowledge of the secrets of the heart
(and nothing therefore is hidden from Him).
v.s: If you disbelieve - indeed, God is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
v.c: If you disbelieve, then ˹know that˺ Allah is truly not in need of you, nor does He approve of disbelief from His servants. But if you become grateful ˹through faith˺, He will appreciate that from you. No soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you of what you used to do. He certainly knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart.

q: (knowing that only Allaah and no other god has the ability to assist).
he forgets for what he supplicated to Allaah before. He then ascribes partners to Allaah, thereby misleading
from Allaah's path. Say, “Enjoy your kufr for a while
You will certainly be from the inmates
v.s: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to God equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
v.c: When one is touched with hardship, they cry out to their Lord, turning to Him ˹alone˺. But as soon as He showers them with blessings from Him, they ˹totally˺ forget the One they had cried to earlier, and set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while! You will certainly be one of the inmates of the Fire.”

q: Or the person who is engrossed
worship throughout the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Aakhirah and hoping for the mercy of his Rabb? Say, “Can those with
knowledge be equal to those who do not have knowledge? Only those with
v.s: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
v.c: ˹Are they better˺ or those who worship ˹their Lord˺ devoutly in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of their Lord? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” None will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason.

m: will be paid back in full
q: of Mine who have Imaan! Fear your Rabb. There shall be good
in this world for those who do good.
(One can always find the opportunity to do good because)
(and if one is prevented from practising Islaam anywhere, then one has the rest of the earth to which to migrate).
shall be granted their reward without reservation.”
v.s: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of God is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."
v.c: Say ˹O Prophet, that Allah says˺, “O My servants who believe! Be mindful of your Lord. Those who do good in this world will have a good reward. And Allah’s earth is spacious. Only those who endure patiently will be given their reward without limit.”

q: (Say, “I have been commanded to worship Allaah, making all
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “Indeed, I have been commanded to worship God, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
v.c: Say, “I am commanded to worship Allah, being sincerely devoted to Him ˹alone˺.

q: “And I have been commanded to be the first of the Mu'mineen.”
v.s: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
v.c: And I am commanded to be the first of those who submit ˹to His Will˺.”

q: Say, “I fear the punishment of a severe day if I disobey my Rabb.”
v.s: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
v.c: Say, “I truly fear—if I were to disobey my Lord—the torment of a tremendous Day.”

q: Say. “I worship Allaah only, making my worship only for Him.”
v.s: Say, "God [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
v.c: Say, “It is ˹only˺ Allah that I worship, being sincere in my devotion to Him.

q: “So worship whatever you wish besides Him
Say, “Verily the losers are those who put themselves and their families at a loss on the Day of Qiyaamah
(by committing kufr and encouraging their families to do the same).
v.s: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
v.c: Worship then whatever ˹gods˺ you want instead of Him.” Say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on Judgment Day. That is indeed the clearest loss.”

q: above them and flames beneath them
that Allaah warns His bondsmen. O my bondsmen! Fear Me!
v.s: They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that God threatens [i.e., warms] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
v.c: They will have layers of fire above and below them. That is what Allah warns His servants with. So fear Me, O My servants!

q: for those who refrain from worshipping
who turn to Allaah. So convey the good news
v.s: But those who have avoided tāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to God - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
v.c: And those who shun the worship of false gods, turning to Allah ˹alone˺, will have good news. So give good news to My servants ˹O Prophet˺—

q: These are the ones whom Allaah has guided, and these are the ones who possess
v.s: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones God has guided, and those are people of understanding.
v.c: those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it. These are the ones ˹rightly˺ guided by Allah, and these are ˹truly˺ the people of reason.

q: (Is the one who abstains from evil better)
Or the one against whom the decree for punishment has been passed
(so deep in kufr that it is as if he is already)
v.s: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
v.c: What about those against whom the decree of torment has been justified? Is it you ˹O Prophet˺ who will then save those bound for the Fire?

q: However, those who fear their Rabb shall have balconies above
Beneath these, there will be rivers flowing. Allaah has made this promise, and Allaah never breaks His promise.
v.s: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of God. God does not fail in [His] promise.
v.c: But those mindful of their Lord will have ˹elevated˺ mansions, built one above the other, under which rivers flow. ˹That is˺ the promise of Allah. ˹And˺ Allah never fails in ˹His˺ promise.

q: Do you not see that Allaah sends rain from the sky, and then channels
in springs within the earth? Thereafter, He brings forth crops of different colours with it
(when the water is used to irrigate fields).
the crops wither away, and you will see it turn yellow
after which Allaah reduces it to chaff
There is certainly a reminder in this for people of intelligence
(reminding them that this world like the crops that now it look so green and flourishing will also one day come to an end).
v.s: Do you not see that God sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
v.c: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky—channelling it through streams in the earth—then produces with it crops of various colours, then they dry up and you see them wither, and then He reduces them to chaff? Surely in this is a reminder for people of reason.

q: Or the person whose heart Allaah has opened to Islaam, because of which he is
upon a light from his Rabb? Destruction be for those whose hearts have hardened against Allaah's remembrance
v.s: So is one whose breast God has expanded to [accept] Islām and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of God. Those are in manifest error.
v.c: Can ˹the misguided be like˺ those whose hearts Allah has opened to Islam, so they are enlightened by their Lord? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened at the remembrance of Allah! It is they who are clearly astray.

q: Allaah has revealed the most superb articulation
with subject matter of similar import
(by people for all time throughout the world).
The bodies of those who fear their Rabb shiver with it, after which their hearts and bodies soften to Allaah's remembrance
This is Allaah's guidance, with which He guides whoever He wills. There can be no guide for the one whom Allaah sends astray.
v.s: God has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of God. That is the guidance of God by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom God leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
v.c: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ has sent down the best message—a Book of perfect consistency and repeated lessons—which causes the skin ˹and hearts˺ of those who fear their Lord to tremble, then their skin and hearts soften at the mention of ˹the mercy of˺ Allah. That is the guidance of Allah, through which He guides whoever He wills. But whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide.

q: (Is the person who abstains from evil better)
will have to face a terrible punishment on the Day of Qiyaamah? It will be said to the oppressors
(the Kuffaar on the Day of Qiyaamah),
v.s: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
v.c: Are those who will only have their ˹bare˺ faces to shield themselves from the awful torment on Judgment Day ˹better than those in Paradise˺? It will ˹then˺ be said to the wrongdoers: “Reap what you sowed!”

q: so the punishment afflicted them from where
v.s: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
v.c: Those before them ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺, then the torment came upon them from where they least expected.

q: in this worldly life, while the punishment of the Aakhirah is worse. If only they knew!
v.s: So God made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
v.c: So Allah made them taste humiliation in this worldly life, but far worse is the punishment of the Hereafter, if only they knew.

q: Verily, We have mentioned every type of example for people in this Qur'aan so that they may take heed
v.s: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
v.c: We have certainly set forth every ˹kind of˺ lesson for people in this Quran, so perhaps they will be mindful.

q: It is an Arabic Qur'aan without any crookedness
v.s: [It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
v.c: ˹It is˺ a Quran ˹revealed˺ in Arabic without any crookedness, so perhaps they will be conscious ˹of Allah˺.

q: Allaah mentions the example of a man who is owned by several masters who keep disputing over him

(each master argues with the other for complete ownership of the slave so that the slave can do his work exclusively. Caught up in this struggle, the slave is also left bewildered, and has to suffer the ill tempers of each upset master, unable to please any of them and therefore unable to receive the favours of any)
and another man who is owned entirely by one person. Can the two be equal?

(Similar is the example of a Mu'min who worships One Allaah and receives everything from Him. He is in a much better position than a Mushrik, who has to pay allegiance to several gods, without receiving anything from any of them.)
to Allaah, but most of them
v.s: God presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to God! But most of them do not know.
v.c: Allah sets forth the parable of a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master. Are they equal in condition? Praise be to Allah! In fact, most of them do not know.
v.h: Parable for a Polytheist and a Monotheist

q: shall certainly die, and they shall all die as well.
v.s: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
v.c: You ˹O Prophet˺ will certainly die, and they will die too.

q: Then, on the Day of Qiyaamah, you will all quarrel
in the presence of your Rabb
(and He will pass the final judgement, condemning the Mushrikeen to Jahannam. Therefore, do not worry about their harassment. Allaah will take them to task for what they do).
v.s: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
v.c: Then on the Day of Judgment you will ˹all settle your˺ dispute before your Lord.

q: Who can be more unjust than he who lies about
when it comes to him? Is there no abode for the Kaafiroon in Jahannam?
(Jahannam is where they will find themselves in the Aakhirah!)
v.s: So who is more unjust than one who lies about God and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
v.c: Who then does more wrong than those who lie about Allah and reject the truth after it has reached them? Is Hell not a ˹fitting˺ home for the disbelievers?
v.h: Reward of the Believers and Disbelievers

q: (accept it to be the absolute truth),
these are the people who have Taqwa
v.s: And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
v.c: And the one who has brought the truth and those who embrace it—it is they who are the righteous.

q: They shall have whatever they desire with their Rabb
This is the reward of those who do good.
v.s: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
v.c: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the good-doers.

q: their evil doings and grant them the best rewards for the good deeds they carried out.
v.s: That God may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
v.c: As such, Allah will absolve them of ˹even˺ the worst of what they did and reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

q: (Rasulullaah ﷺ)!? (Failing to realise that Allaah was always there to protect Rasulullaah ﷺ)
for the one whom Allaah sends astray.
v.s: Is not God sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever God leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
v.c: Is Allah not sufficient for His servant? Yet they threaten you with other ˹powerless˺ gods besides Him! Whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide.

q: None can mislead the one whom Allaah guides. Is Allaah not the Mighty, the Most Capable of avenging
(the harm done to those close to Him)?
v.s: And whoever God guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not God Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
v.c: And whoever Allah guides, none can lead astray. Is Allah not Almighty, capable of punishment?

q: who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly reply, “Allaah!” Say, “Tell me about those whom you worship besides Allaah. If Allaah wishes that any harm should afflict me, can they avert
the harm? Or if Allaah wishes to shower mercy upon me, are they able to restrain
His mercy?” Say, “Allaah is enough for me, and only in Him should those who have trust place their trust.”
(Although the Mushrikeen worshipped many idols, they acknowledged that it was Allaah Who created the universe and Who had control over everything.)
v.s: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "God." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides God? If God intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is God; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
v.c: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah!” Ask ˹them˺, “Consider then whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah: if it was Allah’s Will to harm me, could they undo that harm? Or if He willed ˹some˺ mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy?” Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him ˹alone˺ the faithful put their trust.”

q: Carry out your actions as you are, for I am carrying out mine
(if you will not desist from your evil actions, why should I forsake the good I am doing).
Soon you will come to know...”
v.s: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O my people! Persist in your ways, for I ˹too˺ will persist in mine. You will soon come to know

q: him, and on whom an eternal

(in the Aakhirah).” (You will! soon receive the punishment you deserve. It was not long after this verse was revealed that the Mushrikeen leaders were killed at Badr, to be doomed thereafter to eternal punishment in Jahannam.)
v.s: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
v.c: who will be visited by a humiliating torment ˹in this life˺ and overwhelmed by an everlasting punishment ˹in the next˺.”

q: Without doubt, We have revealed to you
with the truth for the people. Whoever is rightly guided, is guided for his own benefit, and whoever is misguided, then it is to his own detriment
have not been sent as a warder
(you cannot force anyone to accept Imaan and will not be questioned if any one rejects your message).
v.s: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.
v.c: Surely We have revealed to you the Book ˹O Prophet˺ with the truth for humanity. So whoever chooses to be guided, it is for their own good. And whoever chooses to stray, it is only to their own loss. You are not a keeper over them.

q: at the time of their death
(when the time of their death arrives),
(causing them to be oblivious of everything around them as they sleep). (When people are asleep)
Allaah then withholds the soul upon which death has been decreed
(so that the soul does not return to the body),
(allowing them to return to their bodies so that they may continue living)
(until the time when they are due to die).
in this for people who think
(which demonstrates to them that Allaah has complete control over His creation).
v.s: God takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
v.c: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ calls back the souls ˹of people˺ upon their death as well as ˹the souls˺ of the living during their sleep. Then He keeps those for whom He has ordained death, and releases the others until ˹their˺ appointed time. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect.
v.h: Sleep: The Twin Brother of Death

q: (instead of accepting Towheed despite the clear evidence)
“(Do you believe that they can intercede before Allaah)
Even though they do not have control over anything, and
v.s: Or have they taken other than God as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
v.c: Or have they taken others besides Allah as intercessors? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹Would they do so,˺ even though those ˹idols˺ have neither authority nor intelligence?”

q: “(Even though you may believe that the people or angels whom your idols represent shall intercede for you, remember that)
(intercession can take place only with His permission and on behalf of those whom He wills).
To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Eventually, you will all be returned to Him.”
v.s: Say, "To God belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."
v.c: Say, “All intercession belongs to Allah ˹alone˺. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.”

q: When Allaah the One is mentioned
(without mention of their gods, making it clear that only Allaah wields control over the universe),
the hearts of those who do not believe in the Aakhirah contract
besides Allaah are mentioned, they suddenly rejoice
v.s: And when God is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
v.c: Yet when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are filled with disgust. But as soon as those ˹gods˺ other than Him are mentioned, they are filled with joy.

q: (Do not be distressed by their stubbornness, but rather)

Say, “O Allaah! Originator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the unseen and the seen! You shall pass judgement on the Day of Qiyaamah between Your bondsmen concerning the matters about which they differed.”
(When Allaah passes judgement on the Day of Qiyaamah, the Kuffaar will be forced to realise the error of their ways.)
v.s: Say, "O God, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O Allah—Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the seen and unseen! You will judge between Your servants regarding their differences.”

q: (However, this realisation will be too late on the Day of Qiyaamah when nothing will be able to save them. In fact, even)
owned whatever is on earth and much more in addition, they would certainly want to offer it as ransom to escape the evil of the punishment on the Day of Qiyaamah.
(However, even if they did this, it will not be accepted from them.)
to them from Allaah, which they had never imagined.

(On the Day of Qiyaamah, the Kuffaar will see before them everything that they denied in the world. Whereas they expect to receive more wealth and status in the Aakhirah, they will be bitterly disappointed.)
v.s: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from God that which they had not taken into account.
v.c: Even if the wrongdoers were to possess everything in the world twice over, they would certainly offer it to ransom themselves from the horrible punishment on Judgment Day, for they will see from Allah what they had never expected.

q: (Instead of the wealth and riches they expected to find in the Aakhirah,)
The evil of what they earned will become apparent
to them, and they will be enveloped by
v.s: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
v.c: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

q: Thereafter, when We confer a bounty upon him
(by granting him wealth or by restoring his good health),
he says, “I have been granted this because of
(to examine whether he will thank Allaah),
but most of them do not know
(and therefore fail the test by attributing the bounty to themselves, thereby succumbing to Shirk).
v.s: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
v.c: When one is touched with hardship, they cry out to Us ˹alone˺. Then when We shower Our blessings upon them, they say, “I have been granted all this only because of ˹my˺ knowledge.” Not at all! It is ˹no more than˺ a test. But most of them do not know.

q: before them said the same words, but the things that they earned did not benefit them
(could not save them from Allaah's punishment).
v.s: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
v.c: The same had already been said by those ˹destroyed˺ before them, but their ˹worldly˺ gains were of no benefit to them.

q: the evil acts they earned caught up with them
the evil deeds that the oppressive ones among these people earn shall
catch up with them as well. Then
v.s: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
v.c: So the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds overtook them. And the wrongdoers among these ˹pagans˺ will be overtaken by the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds. And they will have no escape.

q: (After understanding the manner in which things happen,)
Do they not know that Allaah increases sustenance for whoever he pleases, and reduces
(and that having and not having sustenance has nothing to do with a person's resourcefulness)?
in this for people who have Imaan.
v.s: Do they not know that God extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
v.c: Do they not know that Allah gives abundant or limited provisions to whoever He wills? Surely in this are signs for people who believe.

q: Never lose hope of Allaah's mercy
(so do not abstain from seeking forgiveness thinking that you will not be forgiven).
(that are free of kufr and Shirk).
Undoubtedly, He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.”
v.s: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of God. Indeed, God forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet, that Allah says,˺ “O My servants who have exceeded the limits against their souls! Do not lose hope in Allah’s mercy, for Allah certainly forgives all sins. He is indeed the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

q: Turn to your Rabb and surrender to Him before punishment afflicts you, after which you will not be assisted
(and none will be able to help you).
v.s: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
v.c: Turn to your Lord ˹in repentance˺, and ˹fully˺ submit to Him before the punishment reaches you, ˹for˺ then you will not be helped.

q: which your Rabb has revealed to you before punishment suddenly afflicts you
v.s: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
v.c: Follow ˹the Quran,˺ the best of what has been revealed to you from your Lord, before the punishment takes you by surprise while you are unaware,

q: (Do all this to avoid the situation after death when)
for the neglect I showed with regard to Allaah
v.s: Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to God and that I was among the mockers."
v.c: so that no ˹sinful˺ soul will say ˹on Judgment Day˺, ‘Woe to me for neglecting ˹my duties towards˺ Allah, while ridiculing ˹the truth˺.’

q: (turn to Allaah and accept Islaam to avoid the situation after death when)
says, “If only Allaah had guided me, I would have certainly been from among those with Taqwa
v.s: Or [lest] it say, "If only God had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."
v.c: Or ˹a soul will˺ say, ‘If only Allah had guided me, I would have certainly been one of the righteous.’

q: (do this to avoid the situation after death when)
says when seeing the punishment, “If only I had a chance
I would certainly be from among those who do good
v.s: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
v.c: Or say, upon seeing the torment, ‘If only I had a second chance, I would have been one of the good-doers.’

q: (Allaah will reply to such a soul by saying,)
came to you, but you rejected them, you were arrogant
v.s: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
v.c: Not at all! My revelations had already come to you, but you rejected them, acted arrogantly, and were one of the disbelievers.”

q: On the Day of Qiyaamah, you will see that the faces of those who lied about Allaah will be dark
(Jahannam is exactly where they will find themselves.)
v.s: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about God [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
v.c: On the Day of Judgment you will see those who lied about Allah with their faces gloomy. Is Hell not a ˹fitting˺ home for the arrogant?

q: will touch them, neither shall they grieve
(over the past as the Kuffaar will do).
v.s: And God will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
v.c: And Allah will deliver those who were mindful ˹of Him˺ to their place of ˹ultimate˺ triumph. No evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

q: Allaah is the Creator of everything, and He is the Administrator
v.s: God is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
v.c: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the Maintainer of everything.

q: of the heavens and the earth belong to him. Those who disbelieve in Allaah's Aayaat are the real losers.
v.s: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of God - it is those who are the losers.
v.c: To Him belong the keys ˹of the treasuries˺ of the heavens and the earth. As for those who rejected the signs of Allah, it is they who will be the ˹true˺ losers.

q: Say, “O ignorant ones! Do you command
me to worship others besides Aliaah?”
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “Is it other than God that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?”
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are you urging me to worship ˹anyone˺ other than Allah, O ignorant ones?”

q: Indeed We have sent revelation to you
(because you will receive no rewards for them in the Aakhirah),
and you will definitely become of the losers.”
v.s: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with God, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.
v.c: It has already been revealed to you—and to those ˹prophets˺ before you—that if you associate others ˹with Allah˺, your deeds will certainly be void and you will truly be one of the losers.

q: “Rather worship Allaah and be among the grateful ones
v.s: Rather, worship [only] God and be among the grateful.
v.c: Rather, worship Allah ˹alone˺ and be one of the grateful.

q: Allaah as He deserves to be revered
(they do not realise His power and greatness as they ought to).
On the Day of Qiyaamah, the entire earth will be in His grasp (control), and the skies will be folded
(this verse is Mutashaabihaat to be interpreted metaphorically).
He is Pure and Exalted above all that they ascribe as partners to Him.
v.s: They have not appraised God with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
v.c: They have not shown Allah His proper reverence—when on the Day of Judgment the ˹whole˺ earth will be in His Grip, and the heavens will be rolled up in His Right Hand. Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺!

q: (the first time to sound the advent of the Day of Qiyaamah),
and everyone in the heavens and the earth will fall unconscious, except those whom Allaah chooses
Thereafter, it will be blown a second time, when they
will all suddenly stand up, watching
v.s: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom God wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.
v.c: The Trumpet will be blown and all those in the heavens and all those on the earth will fall dead, except those Allah wills ˹to spare˺. Then it will be blown again and they will rise up at once, looking on ˹in anticipation˺.

q: with the light of her Rabb, the records of actions will be placed
and the Ambiyaa and witnesses will be brought
and they will not be oppressed
(no one will be deprived of reward for good deeds nor punished for sins they did not commit).
v.s: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.
v.c: The earth will shine with the light of its Lord, the record ˹of deeds˺ will be laid ˹open˺, the prophets and the witnesses will be brought forward —and judgment will be passed on all with fairness. None will be wronged.

q: Every soul will be granted full recompense for what it did. Allaah knows best
v.s: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
v.c: Every soul will be paid in full for its deeds, for Allah knows best what they have done.

q: The Kuffaar will be driven to Jahannam in groups
they arrive there, its gates will be opened
(each time a dweller of Hell comes)
and its keepers will say, “Did the Rusul from among you not come to you, reciting to you the Aayaat of your Rabb and warning you of this day's meeting?” They will say, “Certainly. However,
(we failed to heed their advice. Because we died as Kuffaar,)
the decision of punishment has been passed against the Kuffaar.”
v.s: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word [i.e., decree] of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers."
v.c: Those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in ˹successive˺ groups. When they arrive there, its gates will be opened and its keepers will ask them: “Did messengers not come to you from among yourselves, reciting to you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the coming of this Day of yours?” The disbelievers will cry, “Yes ˹indeed˺! But the decree of torment has come to pass against the disbelievers.”

q: “Enter the gates of Jahannam, where you shall live forever. Evil indeed is the abode of the haughty
v.s: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
v.c: It will be said to them, “Enter the gates of Hell, to stay there forever.” What an evil home for the arrogant!

q: Those who feared their Rabb will be led to Jannah in groups. Until, when they arrive there, its gates will
and its keepers will say, “Peace be on you! May you be pleased. Enter Jannah to live forever.”
v.s: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].
v.c: And those who were mindful of their Lord will be led to Paradise in ˹successive˺ groups. When they arrive at its ˹already˺ open gates, its keepers will say, “Peace be upon you! You have done well, so come in, to stay forever.”

q: They will say, “All praise be to Allaah, Who has fulfilled His promise to us, made us inheritors of this land
so that we may settle wherever we wish in Jannah. Excellent indeed is the reward of those who perform good deeds!”
v.s: And they will say, "Praise to God, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."
v.c: The righteous will say, “Praise be to Allah Who has fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the ˹everlasting˺ land to settle in Paradise wherever we please.” How excellent is the reward of those who work ˹righteousness˺!

q: You shall see the angels thronging around
the Throne, glorifying Allaah's praises. Then, with justice
between people, and it will be said, “All praise belongs to Allaah, the Rabb of the universe.”
v.s: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [God] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to God, Lord of the worlds."
v.c: You will see the angels all around the Throne, glorifying the praises of their Lord, for judgment will have been passed on all with fairness. And it will be said, “Praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds!”
